old_caption: The video captures a scene set in an outdoor area with lush green grass and trees in the background. A large pile of wood is burning brightly, with flames reaching high into the air and smoke billowing out. The fire is intense, illuminating the surrounding area with its warm glow. In the foreground, a mattress lies on the ground, partially visible, with a rusted metal pipe running alongside it. The fire continues to burn steadily throughout the sequence, casting dynamic shadows and highlighting the textures of the burning wood and the grass. There are no animals or other characters present in the video, and the camera remains stationary, focusing on the fire and the immediate surroundings.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a scene set in an outdoor area with lush green grass and trees in the background. A large pile of wood is burning brightly, with flames reaching high into the air and smoke billowing out. The fire is intense, illuminating the surrounding area with its warm glow. In the foreground, a mattress lies on the ground, partially visible, with a rusted metal pipe running alongside it. As the video progresses, a hand appears from the left side of the frame, lifting the mattress slightly off the ground. The hand then moves the mattress to the right, revealing more of the grassy area beneath. The fire continues to burn steadily throughout the sequence, casting dynamic shadows and highlighting the textures of the burning wood and the grass. There are no animals or other characters present in the video, and the camera remains stationary, focusing on the fire and the immediate surroundings.
caption: The video captures an outdoor grassy clearing under a clear sky, where a large open fire burns a pile of wooden planks and debris at left-center, sending dark smoke drifting upward and leftward. The flames flicker and reshape continuously across the segment, while the tree line, horizon, and a haystack at right remain fixed, indicating a largely static camera. In the left foreground lies a light-blue quilted mattress beside a rusty metal bar resting on the grass. In the first frames the mattress rests flat, showing its horizontal top surface and rounded white piping. As the excerpt progresses, the mattress tilts and rises into an upright position along the left edge, revealing its vertical quilted side face. This reorientation gradually occludes the lower-left base of the burning pile. The fire itself keeps burning throughout. The mattress remains standing through the later frames, with no visible operator or mechanism causing the movement.

This clip is a temporally cropped excerpt, with arbitrary start and end boundaries. It is NOT
necessarily a complete action and it is NOT a loop. Describe the visible portion of a process
without inventing how it began or how it ultimately ends. A process may already be happening
on the first frame and still be happening after the last. Do not force the endpoints to match,
infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.
Use the chronological video as primary evidence. The independent visual notes are fallible aids,
not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.
Aim for 85-115% of the original WISA word count,
and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
